comparison.objective: Unlatch a spot-welder battery lid and tip an 18650 cell into a box; candidate commissions a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual hold-and-latch release followed by controlled pouring versus hex-key insertion, fine collar adjustment, relocking and iterative impact testing.
comparison.success_condition: Body requires lid opened, cell boxed, welder replaced and both arms withdrawn; no complete spec version is present. Candidate requires two repeatable safe stops and witness-tested lock retention.
comparison.reason: Shared bimanual stabilization is generic; latch release and gravity extraction do not test adjustable damping.
